hero.filename: Tami Island mask, from Papua New Guinea, late 19th to early 20th century CE. National Museum of Scotland, Edinburgh.jpg
hero.caption: Tami Island mask, from Papua New Guinea, late 19th to early 20th century CE. National Museum of Scotland, Edinburgh, Scotland, UK. Tami Islanders are famous for their carving skills. Traditionally, their wooden carvings were traded and exchanged, over great distances. Today, they continue to be made for the tourist trade.
